meaning: A short official notice or news report.
example: Check the bulletin board for holiday dates.

meaning: Money that you owe to someone.
example: The company paid off its debt early.

meaning: Extra money paid for borrowing or saving money.
example: The bank gives interest on savings.

meaning: A paper that tells a bank to pay money.
example: He gave me a cheque for the rent.
exampleTamil: அவர் வாடகைக்காக எனக்கு ஒரு காசோலை கொடுத்தார்.

meaning: Worry and pressure caused by a difficult situation.
example: Too much work causes stress.

meaning: The person who heads a company or board.
example: The chairman spoke to all the employees.

meaning: A person who works for many clients, not one employer.
example: She works as a freelancer in design.

meaning: The end of a job or a contract.

meaning: Being told to leave your job.

meaning: The power to make decisions and give orders.
example: Only the manager has the authority to approve leave.

meaning: Following rules and controlling your behaviour.
example: Good discipline helps you finish work on time.
exampleTamil: நல்ல ஒழுக்கம் வேலையை நேரத்தில் முடிக்க உதவும்.

meaning: Numbers and facts collected and studied.

meaning: Careful study of something to understand it.

meaning: A formal offer to do work or supply goods for a price.

meaning: An offer of a price to win work or buy something.

meaning: Something valuable that a person or company owns.

meaning: Money put into something to earn more later.

meaning: A person who owns part of a company.

meaning: Part of a company's profit paid to shareholders.

meaning: A book or file where money records are kept.

meaning: The amount by which money spent is more than money earned.

meaning: A general rise in prices over time.

meaning: A period when the economy and business slow down.

meaning: To judge the quality or value of something.

meaning: To become bigger or add more.
